name: 핑두의 감사 선물
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium fantasy RPG inventory gift-box item illustration, square PNG, genuine transparent background.
Primary request: create a brand-new pink luxury gift chest for a Korean game, named in the game UI '핑두의 감사 선물'. No lettering in the artwork. The box must be clearly pink and different from existing blue gift boxes.
Subject: one beautifully crafted open rose-pink chest at a front three-quarter view, compact sturdy rectangular box with refined rose-gold corner fittings, small delicate ornamental embossing, a cream satin ribbon neatly attached to the raised lid, polished jewel clasp. Rich medium pink exterior, blush-pink lining, warm rose-gold metal. Four reward symbols arranged neatly inside: gold coin stacks, one bright golden faceted star, one violet luminous mystic-energy sphere in a small ornamental cradle, and exactly one elegant repair coupon card with a sword-and-circular-return-arrows pictogram. No additional tickets or cards. Keep the interior and all four reward symbols clearly visible and distinguishable at inventory-icon scale.
Style/medium: high-end Korean fantasy mobile RPG item art, highly polished painterly 2D rendering, convincing satin/metal/velvet materials, clean cohesive silhouette, luminous but controlled highlights, excellent object detail without visual clutter.
Composition: entire chest and lid fully visible, centered, occupies around 85 percent of the square, leave transparent margin on all sides, ground contact shadow subtle and soft. Isolated object only; no scene, no opaque background, no text, no digits, no logo, no watermark, no UI border or panel. Preserve true transparency. Pink is the dominant color; avoid making the chest navy, white or mostly gold.
